description:
A ChatTurnKeys document: the claim of one chat turn's turnKey, so a
message sent again with it (a phone that lost the reply and retried)
runs no second turn (chatTurnKeys.py). Its _id is turnKeyId(userId,
turnKey), so a caller only ever reads their own; deleted when the turn
ends unsaved, and by a TTL index on expireAt.

claimId.description: The claiming turn's own random id: only it marks the claim saved or releases it
claimId.title: Claimid

status.description: running until the turn is saved (saved); a turn that ends unsaved deletes it
status.title: Status

conversationId.description: The conversation it was saved in; null before
conversationId.title: Conversationid

runningUntil.description: Past it, a turn still running is failed (its process stopped): as long as a conversation lock
runningUntil.title: Runninguntil

title: ChatTurnKey
